arm_set.name: reduced
arm_set.reason: about 83 s per sequential Unity flight; ten arms x twenty worlds is 200 flights (about 4.6 h) against 80 flights (about 1.8 h) for the four arms the criteria name. No criterion depends on a dropped arm.

decision_rule: Unit = one world, paired across arms. PRODUCTION beats a baseline on a metric iff the lower bound of the 95 % paired percentile-bootstrap CI over worlds (4000 resamples) of the benefit (PRODUCTION better = positive) is > 0. ch25 criteria: 'beats fixed views on actual hidden-state reconstruction' = hidden_state_error_improvement vs A-B1_fixed_inspection; 'beats random views' = the same vs A-B0_random; 'beats coverage-only' = the same vs A-B2_coverage; 'beats simple views on information/time/energy' = info_per_time AND info_per_kj vs each of those three; the closed-loop criterion = MCBR planned in at least one world, at least half of the worlds where it planned produced an informative view, and PRODUCTION's mean hidden_state_error_improvement is above 0. ch25 leaves every numeric margin OPEN: no margin is invented, the directional criterion above is applied, and every paired CI is reported whatever its sign.
